title: Customer requirements survey — Private backup/restore + DR (enterprise)
content:
Notes
- Source: SE calls + security reviews + customer questionnaires. Not all fields provided by all accounts; blanks mean “not stated” (not “no”).
- Interpret “RPO” as max tolerable data loss for control-plane/config state (not customer application data).
- Interpret “RTO” as time to restore Private control plane to an operational state with verified routing/tenant config (not necessarily full historical audit log restore).

Summary (top themes)
1) Storage backends: S3 is the most commonly allowed in VPC installs; on-prem strongly prefers NFS/SMB/object-store-compatible (MinIO/Ceph). Several accounts explicitly disallow “vendor-managed bucket in Redwood account”.
2) Encryption & keys: Every enterprise respondent requires encryption at rest. ~Half require customer-managed KMS keys (CMK). Regulated/on-prem accounts prefer HSM-backed keys and may have KMS downtime constraints.
3) Air-gap: True air-gapped requirements appear in regulated healthcare/public-sector. “No outbound egress except allowlisted” is common even when not fully air-gapped.
4) RPO/RTO: Most ask for RPO <= 1 hour for config DB/control plane. RTO expectations cluster at 2–4 hours for “same-region clean cluster restore” and 4–8 hours for “new cluster / DR scenario”.
5) Audit log retention: Minimum 1 year is common; regulated requires 7 years + immutability/WORM controls. Most want ability to export to existing SIEM/archive.

Table: survey responses (as-of 2025-02-18)
Columns:
Company | Segment | Deployment type | Environment constraints | Desired RPO | Desired RTO | Backup cadence asked | Retention asked | Allowed backup storage backends | Storage notes | KMS/HSM constraints | Key ownership | Air-gap | Egress restrictions | Secrets handling preference | Audit log retention/export | Restore validation expectations | Priority/notes | SE owner

FinBank | Financial services | VPC (AWS), multi-AZ | Private VPC; strict IAM; prefer cross-account patterns | 15 min | 2 hr (same-region), 6 hr (region failover) | Every 15–30 min incremental + daily full | 35 days online + 1 year archive | S3 (customer acct) only | Must support S3 Object Lock + versioning; no public endpoints | AWS KMS CMK required; rotation every 90 days; must tolerate KMS throttling | Customer-managed | No | Outbound egress allowlisted only | “No secret material in backup artifacts; references OK” | 7 years; export to Splunk (HEC) + S3 archive | Automated restore drill in staging monthly; provide signed validation report | Blocker for procurement until DR plan + test plan | Colin O'Donnell

MedData Systems | Healthcare / regulated | On-prem (air-gapped) | No outbound internet; offline updates; strict change control | 1 hr | 4 hr (in-cluster), 8 hr (new cluster) | Daily full + on-demand pre-upgrade backups | 90 days on-site + 7 years archive | NFS only (initially); future: S3-compatible (MinIO) | NFS performance concerns; want checksum + resume support for slow links | HSM-backed keys preferred; KMS not available; offline key ceremony required | Customer-managed | Yes (true air-gap) | None (zero egress) | “Backups must not contain plaintext secrets; include secret refs and provide procedure to re-hydrate” | 7 years; export to immutable archive; evidence for audits (who/when restored) | Restore must be deterministic; offline docs + runbook; smoke tests included | Requires signed bundles + offline verification steps | Fatima Noor

Northwind Insurance | Insurance | VPC (AWS) single-region | Must integrate with existing DR processes | 30 min | 4 hr | Hourly + daily | 30 days | S3 (customer acct) | Wants least-privilege IAM template; separate bucket per env | AWS KMS CMK; key rotation annually; KMS outage: “fail closed OK” | Customer-managed | No | Allowlisted egress | Prefer references only; secrets via external vault | 1 year; export to S3 + SIEM | Wants “restore validation checklist” + API health checks | High priority; aiming for Q2 rollout | Markus Klein

EuroTelco | Telecom | VPC (GCP) multi-zone | EU data residency; audit requirements; prefer GCP-native | 30 min | 3 hr | Hourly | 60 days | GCS only | Must support bucket retention policy + CMEK | Cloud KMS (CMEK) required; no external KMS | Customer-managed | No | Allowlisted egress | “No secrets in artifacts” | 2 years; export to BigQuery + coldline archive | Wants post-restore “tenant config diff” report | Medium; evaluating vs self-host | Markus Klein

PublicSector-Alpha | Public sector | On-prem (restricted) | Limited outbound egress (quarterly patch window) | 4 hr | 24 hr | Daily | 1 year | NFS or SMB | Must be compatible with Windows file servers | HSM required; key escrow process; operator separation of duties | Customer-managed | “Mostly” (restricted) | Outbound egress blocked except during maintenance | Strong preference for references only; strict audit trails | 7 years; export required; tamper-evident logs | Restore must be executable by customer ops without Redwood access | Longer RTO acceptable; documentation is key | Fatima Noor

RetailCo | Retail | VPC (AWS) single-region | Cost-sensitive; OK with “best effort” DR | 1 hr | 8 hr | Daily | 14 days | S3 or EFS | Would accept managed bucket if in their account | AWS KMS CMK preferred but not required for POC | Customer-managed preferred | No | Standard outbound allowed | References OK | 180 days; export optional | Wants simple smoke test script | Low-medium; early stage | Colin O'Donnell

AeroDef Systems | Aerospace/defense | On-prem + private cloud hybrid | Classified segment isolated; separate enclave | 30 min | 12 hr | Hourly for config DB; daily full | 1 year + archive | NFS; S3-compatible (Ceph) | Must support offline transfer between enclaves via removable media | HSM required; keys cannot leave enclave; strict MFA | Customer-managed | Yes (for classified enclave) | None for classified; limited for non-classified | No secrets in artifacts; re-key post-restore required | 7 years; export to offline archive | Wants “break glass” restore procedure; multi-operator approval | Complex; may need custom engagement | Fatima Noor

SaaSScale | B2B SaaS | VPC (AWS) | Wants automation + observability; strong SLO culture | 15 min | 2 hr | Every 15 min + daily | 30 days | S3 | Wants metrics: last_success_ts, duration, bytes, verify status | AWS KMS CMK required; prefer envelope encryption | Customer-managed | No | Allowlisted egress | OK with references only | 1 year; export to SIEM | Requires scheduled restore drill weekly in staging | High; expects productized experience | Sean Gallagher

BioCompute | Biotech | VPC (Azure) | Azure-only corporate standard | 1 hr | 6 hr | Daily | 90 days | Azure Blob only | Needs examples for IAM equivalents | Azure Key Vault keys required; rotation yearly | Customer-managed | No | Allowlisted egress | References only | 2 years; export to Sentinel | Wants documented mapping for “restore to new cluster” | Medium; waiting on Azure support details | Markus Klein

PaymentsCo | Payments | VPC (AWS) multi-AZ | PCI scope; strict separation | 15 min | 4 hr | Every 30 min + daily | 90 days | S3 only | Requires bucket-level access logs + Object Lock | KMS CMK required; must log decrypt operations; key rotation 90 days | Customer-managed | No | Allowlisted egress | References only; integrate with existing secrets manager | 1 year minimum; SIEM export required | Requires evidence artifacts from restore drills (timestamps, versions) | High; PCI assessment depends on runbook quality | Kevin Osei

ResearchLab | Academia | On-prem | Limited staff; wants “easy mode” | 24 hr | 48 hr | Weekly | 30 days | NFS | Simple shared storage | Local keys OK; no HSM | Customer-managed | No | Standard outbound | OK to include some secrets if encrypted (asked, not decided) | 90 days | Wants minimal validation | Low; non-enterprise | Markus Klein

Open questions / follow-ups (tracked in spec draft)
- Define supported “restore targets”: same cluster vs new cluster, same region vs new region (VPC). Several accounts want region failover; likely Phase 2+.
- Clarify audit log backup responsibility boundaries: customers often assume “audit logs included”; we need explicit split (control plane state vs audit log exporter).
- On-prem NFS performance: multiple accounts request resume/partial upload, checksums, and robust retry logic.
- Key rotation: some want 90-day rotation; need stance on backup artifact re-encryption vs “restore-time decrypt with historical DEKs”.
- Evidence artifacts: regulated accounts want a signed/immutable report of backup+restore operations (operator, timestamps, versions, checksums).

Data hygiene
- This sheet contains customer names and requirements; do not share externally. For customer-facing decks, use anonymized segments unless approved by Sales/Legal.
